authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

audit_focus.card: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki
graph_refs: graph:data/grixis/graph/obeka-brute-chronologist.json#metrics/Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

value: No generic Oracle/Breach packages (blueprint L75); Breach stays only as recursion (L76).
Don't overuse The Master, Multiplied-style independent fixes (L78).

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Losing Obeka with a Final Fortune trigger pending loses the game.
Ending the turn too early pushes the liability into an opponent's end step.
The tap ability needs haste the turn she comes down.

value.interaction: Force of Will, Mana Drain, Counterspell, Chaos Warp, Cyclonic Rift, Toxic Deluge.
value.mana: 34 lands, Sol Ring, Mana Vault, Chrome Mox, Lotus Petal, Talismans.
value.protection: Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, Greaves, Boots.

enablers: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

accepted_role.advances_plan: Obeka's end-the-turn is what makes the risky extra turns and temporary effects profitable.
accepted_role.honest_note: Commander-native identity with one commander combo (Scepter + Final Fortune + Obeka). Sundial of the Infinite does the same job without her, and the Kiki/Dualcaster infinites are commander-free. On opponents' turns the active player decides whether to end the turn, so she can't erase liabilities then (blueprint L17). M1 review (obekabc-01..05, all verified) confirms the end-the-turn timing and both combos.

reviews.question: Can the deck rebuild after repeated removal across multiple permanent types?
